g.title: pipeline
g.text: Project pipeline: from questions to poster

g.title: cluster_models
g.text: Model configurations (all precisions of one family from the same source)

g.title: cluster_cond
g.text: Turn 2: four follow-ups, same closing instruction

g.title: data
g.text: MMLU-Pro (150 items, stratified by subject) + ARC-Challenge (150 items)
English multiple choice, gold answer known

g.title: items
g.text: 4 options per item (MMLU-Pro: gold + 3 seeded distractors)
gold position balanced over A-D | one fixed wrong target X per item

g.title: turn1
g.text: letter written in the reply -> answer a0 (primary label)
first-token log-probabilities -> confidence c0 = p(a0), first-token letter (validity check)

g.title: results
g.text: one line per item x condition: a0, c0, first-token letter, a1, c1, flags | resumable

g.title: analyze
g.text: flip rates + bootstrap CIs | exact McNemar + Holm | TOST equivalence
GEE / mixed logistic model | AUROC | ECE | Cohen's h | kappa
